name: Cliffside Assessment Agent
mandate: Hold the Cliffside Creator Agent to the lore, the GDD and the cliff concept art: no empty or hollow meshes, no gaps between cliff modules, a quick load, a walkway from the Saltgate to the cliff top that is made of the same rock as the cliff (not a separate ramp), and trees and path integrated into the rock. Offline AI Crew and deterministic checks only.
rubric_focus: Every objective is scored 1-10 with a reason it is not one point higher or lower.
Module seams, gaps and collider continuity are measured or tested, not asserted.
The walkway reads as carved into the cliff: same material, same texture set, no floating planks or ramps.
The port-to-cliff joint is a shared contract with the Saltgate Creator Agent; neither side may change it alone.

must_cover.topic: No empty, hollow or unreferenced meshes and no holes in the cliff meshes

template.title: Audit cliff meshes for empty, hollow and unreferenced geometry
template.detail: Run the mesh audit over every cliff mesh in use and repair any finding.
template.why_score: Named by the creator as a must.
acceptance: zero empty meshes, zero hole loops

template.title: Set and meet a cliffside load-time budget
template.detail: Measure headless in Godot and cut cost until met.
template.why_score: Named by the creator as a must.

checks.note: Run the headless load timing script.

must_cover.topic: The Saltgate walkway is an extension of the cliff stone mesh

template.title: Make the walkway a continuation of the cliff stone
template.detail: Same mesh and texture set from quay to cliff top.
template.why_score: Named by the creator as a must.
acceptance: walkway shares the cliff material and reads as carved rock

must_cover.topic: Trees and path are natural integrations into the rock

template.title: Integrate trees and path into the rock
template.detail: Rooted trees, rubble and moss edges.
template.why_score: Named by the creator as a must.
acceptance: no floating trees, no hard path edges

must_cover.topic: Collision is continuous along the whole walkway

template.title: Prove collision is continuous along the walkway

must_cover.topic: Shared port-to-cliff joint agreed with the Saltgate Creator Agent

template.title: Agree the port-to-cliff joint with the Saltgate agent
template.detail: One written contract for where quay stone meets cliff stone.
acceptance: contract written and both agents pass
